related_questions.question: How much is $100,000 after taxes in the UK?
related_questions.snippet: Calculation details On a £100,000 salary, your take home pay will be £68,557.40 after tax and National Insurance. This equates to £5,713.12 per month and £1,318.41 per week. If you work 5 days per week, this is £263.68 per day, or £32.96 per hour at 40 hours per week.

related_questions.question: What is a 70k salary after tax in the UK?
related_questions.snippet: On a £70,000 salary, your take home pay will be £51,157.40 after tax and National Insurance. This equates to £4,263.12 per month and £983.80 per week. If you work 5 days per week, this is £196.76 per day, or £24.59 per hour at 40 hours per week.
